exact: protein secretion by the type II protein secretion system
related: protein secretion by the general secretion pathway
protein secretion by the general secretory pathway

definition: The process in which proteins are secreted across the outer membrane of Gram-negative bacteria by the type II secretion system. Proteins using this pathway are first translocated across the cytoplasmic membrane via the Sec or Tat pathways.
label: protein secretion by the type II secretion system
